about.eyebrow: A public inquiry into human flourishing
paragraphs: Human flourishing requires more than sound money, more than good technology, and more than good intentions. It requires deliberate choices about how the systems governing daily human life are built — and those choices are being made right now, largely without public deliberation, with consequences that will be very difficult to reverse. This is a long-term inquiry into that architecture: what it is, how it fails, and what it would take to build it well.

The inquiry begins with a book — Abundance Architecture, in development — and extends through the sites, the conversation, and the public dialog that follows. The goal is a conversation serious enough to match the scale of what is at stake.
